adjustment_candidates.description: H1 2026 stock compensation is recurring economic compensation and should not be automatically normalized away.
H1 2026 OCF benefited from approximately $884.0M of AP/accrued/insurance changes and $700.2M of contract-liability increases, partly offset by receivable/contract-asset/inventory investment.
Growth includes material acquisition contributions; acquisitions used $3.30B cash in FY2025 and $930.3M in H1 2026.

extraction_warnings.message: PWR has material funded debt (~$6.1B) after acquisition-led expansion; valuation must use net debt, not a net-cash assumption.
H1 2026 OCF contains large favorable working-capital movements; raw TTM FCF should be normalized against FY2026 company FCF guidance.
Acquisitions materially contribute to reported growth, so organic demand and acquired growth should be separated.
